intro.title: A Little About Me
intro.paragraph1: I am Abdulrahman Nasser Al-Mughyir, an Intermediate Diploma graduate in Full-Stack Web Development from the Applied College at Taibah University in Madinah. I combine web development knowledge with practical experience in digital systems, data organization, operations, and administrative work.
intro.paragraph2: My professional experience includes hotel reception, sales, and point-of-sale operations, alongside independent and academic web projects. I value technology, accuracy, information organization, and problem-solving, and I aim to contribute to a productive professional environment while continuing to develop my skills.
